notes: Append to custody.json. pools.fee_pct_by_year already covers 2010-2016 (do not repeat); these add named real pools as reference rows, and the altcoin selling limits. Altcoins are always held in the player wallet (doc 51 v1.0 §5): exchange collapses move price and trust only.

pools_reference_fees.source: Bitcoin Wiki, Comparison of mining pools (doc 53 B1)

altcoin_selling_limits.volume_rule: use the week's real daily volume (market file, CoinMarketCap [A]) where present, else the year's average below

slippage.value: price -1% for each further 0.5% of average daily volume

2011.source: doc 55 §8: not found; scaled from the 2013 average by market cap

handover.altcoins: sold over 2016Q4 within the selling limits, at the weekly prices; any left after the cap converts at the 2016Q4 close x 0.9 (designed haircut); no altcoin enters Act I

chapter_report_later_prices.why: one fixed, well-known date; a latest-year close would date the line (doc 51 §14 decision 6)
